response.overview: Da-hae, an employee of a small business travel agency who killed the team leader after reporting the end of the world. However, afterwards, there was news that the asteroid was out of orbit and the Earth would not end, and Da-hae decided to cover up the team leader's body and leave for Iceland. At the very moment when she is about to leave the travel agency with a carrier containing the team leader's body, she encounters Assistant Manager Park, who has come to work on time. Da-hae should go to Iceland.
response.title: ICELAND
